The key idea of policy masking is building a so-called masking function for the control policy that, with high probability, will guard the control policy from making unsafe steps within the masked control policy space. Building a masking function allows to transform constrained policy optimization to unconstrained over the masked policy and sufficiently simplifies the optimization task. The idea of building a masking function is based on the unsafe state set known a priori for each task. If the unsafe set is known, we can calculate the one-step backward set. This safety approach can guarantee cumulative constraint satisfaction for each task. Technically, the idea of masking unsafe policies can be realized by implementing a retrainable safety layer in a deep neural network. A similar idea, but for a stationary MDP, was proposed by Dalal et. al Dalal et al. ( 2018 ) .
